description: Alpha-cluster test - building everything from species (no hierarchical blocks)

targets.name: Be8_FromScratch
targets.description: Be8 built from 8 species (2 alpha clusters)
targets.notes: Test: Can Be8 form from scratch? Expected low success (~0.25^2 = 0.06%)

targets.name: C12_Triangle_FromScratch
targets.description: C12 via 3 alpha clusters in triangle - from scratch
targets.notes: Test vs C12 flat. Should be similar (~0.18%) if cluster doesn't help

targets.name: C12_Linear_FromScratch
targets.description: C12 via 3 alpha clusters in line - from scratch
targets.notes: Control: Linear should be less stable than triangle

experiment_notes.hypothesis: If cluster topology helps, C12_triangle should succeed more than C12_flat even when built from scratch

expected_results.Be8: ~0.06% (very low - two alphas must form simultaneously)
expected_results.C12_Triangle: ~0.18% (similar to flat if topology doesn't matter)

experiment_notes.critical_test: If C12_Triangle ≈ C12_Flat, then cluster structure gives NO advantage when built from scratch
experiment_notes.no_degradation: Single Kuramoto iteration - no 'clone of clone' issue
